admission.justification: Deterministic identity alone could reuse an archive, live-only placement alone could duplicate on retry, and either without the bound could traverse forever; identity, finite traversal, preservation and hidden-replay interpretation jointly make recovery safe.

guarantee: Explicit task workspace preparation traverses a bounded deterministic successor chain after an archived, archiving or hidden completed replay, preserving live-task identity and old archives, refusing misplaced descriptors, and returning only a refreshed live workspace; retries converge through the host creation ledger.
title: Task workspace recovery preserves retry identity and archived history
